source.name: American Family Insurance newsroom: 'Atlanta United harkens back to the "Spirit of ’96" for Community Kit'
source.quote: For the 10th consecutive season, American Family Insurance is the centerpiece partner for the club’s First Team kits.
source.note: The release says The Connector, the 2025 primary kit, returns in 2026 as the primary kit; American Family Insurance is the front 'centerpiece' partner.

source.name: American Family Insurance newsroom: 'Atlanta United harkens back to the "Spirit of ’96" for Community Kit'
source.quote: Emory Healthcare, the club’s Official Team Healthcare Provider, returns for its second year as a sleeve sponsor for Atlanta United
source.note: The club's own Emory announcement says the logo 'will be featured on the sleeve'; this 2026 release confirms a second year as sleeve sponsor.

source.name: SportsLogos.Net: 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

summary: The Connector, the club's black-and-red 5-Stripes primary kit, drawn from the Downtown Connector and worn again in 2026. American Family Insurance is on the front for a tenth season; Emory Healthcare is the club's sleeve sponsor; the league-wide Apple TV+ patch is on the left sleeve of every MLS kit.
